summary:
PentEarth is a flood early-warning and impact system built on SAR radar. It detects flooded areas from NISAR/SAR imagery, then combines rainfall flow direction and catchments with the footprints of past floods. From this it estimates where a flood is likely to spread and which areas it will affect, and it keeps this knowledge in memory to use when a new flood begins.
On the map, it marks roads that are flooded, closed, or unsafe to enter or leave. It sends warnings and information to the relevant agencies (disaster management, roads, health, electricity distribution). It also compares flow data with the locations of transformers and electrical infrastructure, and flags places with a risk of electric shock as warning or restricted zones.
We built and tested the system on one region, Chókwè in Mozambique, and compared the results with reference flood maps. If we can detect a flood’s location and impact in advance in one region, the same structure can be generalized to other regions.
Flood losses often come from late and incomplete information. PentEarth turns radar data into clear, location-specific warnings that help people reach safety and protect critical infrastructure.
details:
Project Overview and Objective:

PentEarth is an innovative solution designed to optimize environmental monitoring and data analysis workflows. The primary objective of our project is to process complex geospatial and environmental datasets to deliver fast, reliable, and user-friendly insights.

How It Works & Functionality:

The system ingests and processes specialized datasets (such as satellite and spatial data) to perform automated analyses. It empowers users to make rapid decisions in critical scenarios, streamlining operational workflows and saving valuable time.

Key Benefits:

* Rapid and accurate data processing capabilities.

* Intuitive interface ensuring high accessibility.

* High accuracy in environmental and spatial analytics.

Technologies and Tools Used:

During the development process, we leveraged modern programming languages, advanced geospatial data processing libraries, and cloud-based tools. Our codebase and architecture are built to be modular, robust, and scalable.

Innovative Approach:

Unlike existing conventional tools, PentEarth offers a streamlined and accessible approach from both a technical infrastructure and a user experience perspective, paving the way for more sustainable environmental tracking.
